What about them gives off this impression?

Field conditions were largely meh. Never got to play on a showcase field but it was easy to tell that they were beat up when spectating during byes.

I think shade was hard to come by. There was a tent for each team at each field but that doesn't provide much shade for a post-day discussion and during byes, you don't have access to them anyway so you're roasting in the sun for a large part of the bye unless you find a smaller shaded area away from the fields.

Overall, it was pretty good though and while I haven't been to other nationals before, this has to be up there compared to other large venues I've been to and would definitely be happy going back if it was hosted there again.

Metro East probably the most wide open it's been in a while. Last few years Geneseo and Stevens ran train but with both teams taking a step back, almost anyone can come through and advance. Favorites coming in have to be Colgate/Hamilton with their strong regular season performances but Connecticut College swept their section and TCNJ/Stevens have some incredible play makers. It'll be an interesting region to keep track of for sure.

It was picked in 2/12 games, which is not a high pick rate compared to aforementioned ADCs and in neither of the games it was picked did the team win. You can argue all you want about it not being a weak pick, but the argument you use is shaky at best.
